```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(Biostrings)
library(seqinr)
library(ape)
library(DECIPHER)
library(ggtree)
```

## 2. Get Sequences from NCBI

```{r fetch-sequences}
virus <- c("JX869059", "AY508724", "MN908947", "AY390556",
           "AY278489", "MN985325", "AY485277", "MT292571")

# Fetch sequences from NCBI Nucleotide
sequences <- read.GenBank(virus)
sequences
```

## 3. Save Sequences to a Single FASTA File

```{r save-fasta}
write.dna(sequences, file = "virus_sequences.fasta", format = "fasta")
cat("FASTA file saved as 'virus_sequences.fasta'\n")
```

## 4. Load into DNAStringSet and Report Name & Length

```{r dna-stringset}
dna_sequences <- readDNAStringSet("virus_sequences.fasta")

# Report name and length of each sequence
seq_info <- data.frame(
  Name   = names(dna_sequences),
  Length = width(dna_sequences)
)

print(seq_info)
```

## 5. Multiple Alignment with DECIPHER & Save Result

```{r alignment}
# Perform multiple alignment
aligned <- AlignSeqs(dna_sequences)

# Save aligned sequences to a new FASTA file
writeXStringSet(aligned, filepath = "virus_aligned.fasta")
cat("Aligned sequences saved as 'virus_aligned.fasta'\n")
```

## 6. Create Distance Matrix with seqinr

```{r distance-matrix}
# Read aligned FASTA with seqinr
aligned_seqinr <- read.alignment("virus_aligned.fasta", format = "fasta")

# Compute distance matrix
dist_matrix <- dist.alignment(aligned_seqinr, matrix = "similarity")
dist_matrix
```

## 7. Visualize the Distance Matrix

```{r heatmap}
# Convert to regular matrix for visualization
dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist_matrix)

# Heatmap
heatmap(dist_mat,
        main    = "Distance Matrix — Coronavirus Sequences",
        xlab    = "Virus",
        ylab    = "Virus",
        col     = heat.colors(256),
        margins = c(10, 10))
```

## 8. Create the Phylogenetic Tree (ape)

```{r build-tree}
# Build Neighbor-Joining tree from distance matrix
nj_tree <- nj(dist_matrix)
nj_tree
```

## 9. Plot with ape

```{r plot-ape}
plot(nj_tree,
     main       = "Phylogenetic Tree — Coronaviruses (ape)",
     type       = "phylogram",
     cex        = 0.7,
     tip.color  = "steelblue",
     edge.color = "gray40",
     edge.width = 1.5)

add.scale.bar(length = 0.05, col = "black", lwd = 2)
title(sub = "NJ Tree | Kimura Distance | DECIPHER Alignment", cex.sub = 0.7)
```

## 10. Plot with ggtree

```{r plot-ggtree}
ggtree(nj_tree, color = "gray30", size = 0.8) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, color = "steelblue4", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_treescale(fontsize = 3, linesize = 0.5, offset = 0.002) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(
    title    = "Phylogenetic Tree — Coronaviruses (ggtree)",
    subtitle = "SARS-CoV | SARS-CoV-2 | MERS-CoV variants",
    caption  = "NJ Tree · DECIPHER alignment · seqinr distance"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray50"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 8,  color = "gray60")
  )
```
